Ash Heap as playing the Day op to save your vamp would be an abuse of
the spirit of the card.
Action costs are payed if succesful and the cost of paying is to send
the vamp off to the ash pile.. Being in Torpor would not prevent
that. This is still a nasty combo since you get the benefit of the
Day op without the penalty.
